requiredContracts: newest same-mailbox Health request exclusively owns state.health and Health DOM presentation
stale Health success cannot overwrite a newer success
stale Health failure cannot overwrite a newer success
stale request finalization cannot clear busy state owned by a newer request
cleanup completion triggers immediate authoritative Health refresh without arbitrary timing delays
